transport: RS-485 on two RJ-45 jacks marked COMM 1 and COMM 2, vendor-documented as "For RS-485 networking and MODBUS Serial Communication Protocol". Baud rate, framing, parity and default slave ID are NOT published by Samlex and are recorded here as null. A separate pair of RJ-45 jacks, COM 3 and COM 4, is documented as CANbus "(for future use)".

unmappedReports: "AC source in use" / transfer-switch position — whether the unit is inverting, passing shore AC through, or passing generator AC through. Displayed on the EVO-RC-PLUS, not readable over any wire. There is no MetricKind for which AC source is feeding the loads, and on a cabin with a generator input that is the single most operationally important fact about the inverter., "Power Saving" mode state — the EVO's low-idle mode, distinct from off and from inverting. No MetricKind covers a three-state inverter run mode; switch-state is boolean., "GS DETECT TIME" countdown before the generator-start logic fires — a pre-trigger timer with no MetricKind. Note: these three are read off the EVO-RC-PLUS display, NOT off a communications port. Nothing in this list is reachable over a cable today.
